structure.title: Why one frame can last five years
structure.description: Each frame is milled from a single block of aerospace-grade titanium. Light, durable, and resistant to deformation — you're buying not just a frame, but years of comfort.
structure.microHinges.title: Screwless micro-hinges
structure.microHinges.description: Frictionless, screwless articulation that opens smoothly and won't loosen over time. Still feels new after years of use.
structure.ultralight.title: 14g ultralight chassis
structure.ultralight.description: Weighing under 14 grams, you'll barely notice it after a full day. No more red marks on your nose, no more pressure at your temples.
optics.title: See clearly. See longer.
optics.card1.title: High-clarity resin lenses
optics.card1.description: Optical-grade CR-39 resin lenses with outstanding clarity at half the weight of glass. High prescriptions won't look bulky, and your eyes stay relaxed over long hours.
optics.card2.title: Glare & fatigue control
optics.card2.description: A proprietary tinting process filters specific wavelengths to reduce eye strain when driving, working at a screen, or under harsh light.
optics.card3.title: Easy-clean oleophobic layer
optics.card3.description: A nano-coating repels water and oils. Fingerprints wipe off in one motion, and your view stays clear in rain and outdoors.

faq.title: Your questions about buying glasses online, answered
faq.q1: What data do I need to provide for a prescription order?
faq.a1: You only need a prescription from within the past year, including SPH, CYL, AXIS, and pupillary distance (PD). We'll guide you through entering it at checkout and validate the ranges in real time.
faq.q2: Is the AR try-on the same as the real thing?
faq.a2: AR try-on shows how the frame fits your face and its overall style. The actual lens power and frame color are subject to the physical product you receive.
faq.q3: How do I choose lens thickness?
faq.a3: We offer three refractive indices: 1.56, 1.61, and 1.67. The higher your prescription, the higher index we recommend to keep the lens edges slim. The config lab will suggest one based on your prescription.
faq.q4: Can I return it if it doesn't suit me?
faq.a4: Unopened frames are eligible for a 7-day no-question return or exchange. Custom lenses cannot be returned due to the personal prescription, but we will remake them free of charge for any quality issue.
faq.a5: Yes. The config lab supports the full range: SPH ±20.00, CYL ±6.00, AXIS 0–180°.
faq.q6: How long until I receive my order?
faq.a6: The standard lead time is 10 business days, including lens crafting, optical inspection, and delivery. Once shipped, the tracking number appears in your account page.
cta.title: Try it on before you buy
